# Meridian agent instructions

On every new question in this repository:

1. Fetch the latest `meridian-agency-2-0` from GitHub.
2. Read `AGENTS.md` and `MERIDIAN-SESSION-SYNC.md`.
3. Treat those files as current state. Ignore stale Railway live URLs in older docs.
4. Commit finished work back to `meridian-agency-2-0`. Never merge `master` unless Kenny explicitly orders it.
